_about: Documentation for the MINIMAL intent object returned by POST /api/v1/ai/intent (inside the response's `intent` field). The intent deliberately carries ONLY the target table(s) and the action — nothing that could be guessed inaccurately. All query details (measures, dimensions, segments, filters, time, order, limit) are chosen downstream by the Cube query generator from the live /meta. This file is documentation only; app/schemas/intent.py is the source of truth.

_key_catalog.query: string — the original user question, echoed back verbatim.
_key_catalog.table: enum|null — primary target table. One of: pre_auth | claims | hospitalization | hospitals. null if not determinable.
_key_catalog.related_tables: string[] — every OTHER table needed via joins (e.g. hospitals when the ask is 'by hospital'). Empty array if none.
_key_catalog.action: enum|null — what the user wants: count | sum | avg | min | max | list | trend | ranking | lookup. null if not determinable.
_key_catalog.answerable: boolean — false when the question can't be served by these tables (table/action left null).

sample.query: total approved claim amount by hospital last 30 days

examples.query: list denied claims with claim numbers
top 5 hospitals by total claimed amount
monthly trend of pre-auth submissions this year
show me the weather forecast for tomorrow
